preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner or an authorized address
Contract must hold BNB balance or token balances that can be stolen

exploit_hint: As owner or authorized address, call the cSb() function with a high percentage (e.g., 100) to drain all BNB from the contract to the tfU address (which can be set to attacker's address via setrecadd). Alternatively, use approvals() to drain BNB to krhF, mdhS, wthT, extR addresses (which can also be set to attacker's addresses). Also consider using setswap() to steal any ERC20 tokens held by the contract.
